title: You can change any setting from the template defaults before saving
custom_preconds: 1. You started from the Service Advisor template on the Create Role page.
custom_steps:
1. On the Schedule card, untick Delete.
  2. Confirm Schedule View and Create & Edit stay ticked.
  3. In Page Access, turn Reports on.
  4. Type a Role name.
  5. Click Create.
  6. Afterwards open the role's Permission Summary.
custom_expected:
Delete unticks; Schedule View and Create & Edit stay ticked.

Reports turns on.

Create works.

The Permission Summary shows Schedule with View and Create & Edit only and Reports on.
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live role editor / roles list)
